en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 5. Ahmad ibn `Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim said, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of Yunus ibn `Abd al-Rahman, on the authority of Ibn Bukayr, on the authority of Hamzah ibn Muhammad that I asked Abu `Abd Allah
about the Word of Allah, the Mighty and High: And pointed out to him the two conspicuous ways.” He (AS) said; “They are the way of good and the way of evil.”
